title: Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test VTB began letting qualified investors trade bitcoin in its app on Friday, a day after the Bank of Russia approved the knowledge test every crypto buyer must pass. SPB Exchange plans to open spot trading Dec. 1. This post Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
